title: Radio: John Lennon on WNEW-FM | 1975
content:
John Lennon made an appearance on WNEW-FM in New York City on the afternoon of 13 February 1975.

He dropped in at the station’s studio during Scott Muni’s 2-6pm show. They discussed Lennon’s recent Rock ‘N’ Roll album, with Lennon giving a track-by-track guide.

During the show he also revealed that he and Yoko Ono had recently reunited following their 18-month separation.

Lennon had previously appeared on WNEW-FM on 28 September 1974.
